Their daytime packages have no place, so only the hour is known. Atub's waking package is a sandbox around a spot with no named cell (most likely outdoors); only her sleep spot is the longhouse.

The shrine northwest of Largashbur is the Orc skeleton's spot, which is out in the open world; the place the records call the Sanctum of Malacath shares Fallowstone Cave's map marker, so it is the giants' grove inside the cave, not the shrine with the skeleton. The direction comes from Atub's line and the journal.

Getting the spell choice and some talk with Yamarz and Ugor depend on speech checks and other conditions that aren't fully decoded here; that you need to know Bane of the Undead is read from the objective, not from a condition.

Volendrung and the necklace are script properties; which ending gives which isn't spelled out, and two other completing endings have no journal text. Yamarz promises to pay you for the escort, but no gold is named in the records. The script's giant-club Shagrol's Warhammer isn't a playable item, so it is left out.
The objective says Garok Longstride; the giant's own record is named Gorak Longstride.
